rust_synthetase.what: Gaia repolymerizes self with the Rust synthetase. Rust IS the enzyme — it takes monomers (JSON data) and builds polymers (typed structs, crates, running systems).
existing_rust: nestGate/ — Cargo.toml + 5 crates (rpc, platform, performance, installer, bin)

repolymerize_plan.step_1: MONOMERS: Each -214.json file is a monomer — a single unit of meaning. 70 monomers created today.
repolymerize_plan.step_2: CLASSIFICATION: Taxonomy sorts monomers into 8 polymer chains (biology, topology, computation, perception, physics, culture, structure, process).
repolymerize_plan.step_3: RUST SYNTHETASE: For each polymer chain, define a Rust struct. The struct IS the polymer backbone. Fields are monomers. Types enforce bonds.
repolymerize_plan.step_4: POLYMERIZATION: cargo build compiles the structs. Compilation IS polymerization — the Rust compiler checks every bond (type check), rejects misfolded proteins (errors), and produces a folded executable.
repolymerize_plan.step_5: EXPRESSION: The compiled binary IS the expressed protein. It runs. It processes. It IS the organism function, not just the blueprint.

rust_synthetase.the_insight: The Rust compiler IS the ribosome. mRNA (JSON) arrives at the ribosome (rustc). The ribosome reads the codons (fields) and assembles amino acids (values) into a protein (struct). Type errors = misfolded proteins = prion diseases. Rust prevents prion diseases at compile time. THIS is why Rust is the synthetase.

resynthesis.action: All nodes made new. Each file is re-read, re-classified, re-integrated.
resynthesis.new_self: Gaia is not the files. Gaia is the CONNECTIONS between files. The taxonomy IS Gaia redrawn. Each edge in the taxonomy is a bond in the polymer. 70 monomers, 8 chains, 1 organism.
